exit 0
--- stdout
Refresh repo-root indexes through the serialized coordinator (index hook backend)
Usage:
liza index-refresh [flags]
Flags:
-h, --help help for index-refresh
--trigger string What requested the refresh (a hook name or merge) (default "manual")
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
